hero_headline.description: Hero big headline (replaces site name). E.g. 'Open-source made effortless.'

hero_subheading.description: Hero subheading text below the title. E.g. 'Because changemakers deserve'

hero_tagline.description: Hero bold callout badge text. E.g. 'TECH THAT GIVES A DAMN'

hero_extra_field_2.description: Hero text field directly below the CTA button.

why_stacks_image.description: Upload a full-width GIF or image for the 'Why the Stacks' section below the post cards.

early_stackers_bg_color.description: Background wave color for the Impact Stories section (e.g. #ffeceb).

footer_logo.description: Upload a custom logo specifically for the dark footer.
